exceptions.rationale: Python installer package packaged inside python:3.12-slim base image. Web app does not invoke pip at runtime.
exceptions.exploitability_condition: Malicious local package installation via crafted pip command.
exceptions.compensating_controls: Production container executes as unprivileged 'appuser' with no write permissions to python site-packages; no pip CLI invocations in web server.
exceptions.remediation_plan: Upgrade base image when official Debian/Python releases updated slim image or upgrade pip during build.
